text: Just testet it. So far so good. Should have a mode where I don't need to klick on every task, but it rather just reads every task and tells me how many minutes I have, one task after another in a loud voice so the phone can stay in one room, while I change rooms, clothes etc. Maybe i didn't find the option yet.
author: mora morlock
developer_reply: Hello! This is Routinery💛 Thank you for your review! We're so glad you like the app. It sounds like you're looking for our auto-advance feature! You can enable it in the Quick Mode on the to-do list page. If you turn it on, the app will automatically move to the next task. If you have any more suggestions, please let us know at hello@routinery.app
